title: ModelCitizens: Representing Community Voices in Online Safety

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity annotations (missed harm vs. amplified harm) from ingroup versus outgroup annotators on social media posts targeting Asian, Black, Latino, and Mexican communities, and evaluating toxicity detection models' alignment with the ingroup ground truth.

Analyzing annotator disagreement between ingroup and outgroup individuals for content targeting Jewish and Muslim groups, and evaluating the accuracy of various language models in detecting toxicity against these specific communities.

Measuring differences in toxicity perception between women (ingroup) and outgroup annotators for posts targeting women, and benchmarking LLMs' toxicity classification performance using the community-aligned labels.

bias_targets.target: Sexual orientation and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity ratings of conversational social media context between LGBTQ+ annotators and outgroup annotators to identify annotation disparities, and testing AI moderation tools against LGBTQ+ community standards.
